infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KVJ FlowDesk needs your location to verify GPS clock-in attendance at assigned offices and colleges.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KVJ FlowDesk needs access to your camera to take classroom attendance photos and upload expense receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KVJ FlowDesk needs access to your photo library to select receipt photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow KVJ FlowDesk to use your location for attendance punches.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you upload classroom attendance photos and receipts.
